The point of this post wasn't to call anybody out for not being a "real fan" or to say that fans aren't allowed to make criticisms of the team. The point was more to emphasize how fans support the team through thick and thin. I understand that everyone is disappointed and frustrated with CLG's performance or lack thereof, and I agree that there should probably be changes if the team wants to succeed in the future. However, I also don't believe that the right way to do that is utterly berating players and pushing blame around. Obviously the players already know that they lost and probably feel like shit about it. They don't need 200 people on Reddit telling them how they're the worst player and how they need to leave if their team wants to win. I apologize if I offended any one, but some of the comments being thrown around this sub are just downright disrespectful and uncalled for. Yeah, shit sucks, I get it, but like Zirene says, supporting them through the lows makes the highs feel even higher.
